movelist.name: Trick
movelist.effect: Both targets must be hit for Trick to succeed. The user may target itself or willing allies with Trick; you do not need to roll for Accuracy Check in these cases. Both targets lose their Held Item or Accessory Slot Item, and gain the other target’s Held Item or Accessory Slot Item. If a target has no Item, it still can gain the other target’s Item.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Trick-or-Treat
movelist.effect: The target gains the Ghost Type in addition to its other Types for 5 turns.

movelist.name: Leech Seed
movelist.effect: At the beginning of each of the target’s turns, Leech Seed’s target loses a Tick of Hit Points. Leech Seed’s user then gains Hit Points equal to the amount the target lost. Leech Seed lasts until the target faints or is returned to a Poké Ball. Grass Types and targets immune to Grass Attacks are immune to Leech Seed.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!
